name: as_of_month_day is ignored under a week row axis because the week branch wins
description: Under both axes the week branch of keeptradecut_join takes the boundary, so a well-formed as_of_month_day reaches params and does not affect the emitted boundary: the SQL must carry to_timestamp(nfl_year_week_timestamp.week_timestamp) and no make_date at all, and no recency floor, which is year-axis only. This is the accepted-and-ignored shape recorded in the plan -- accepted only because the client control hides itself under a week axis, so the state is reachable solely by removing a year axis from a saved view. The alias still differs from the unset one, so a stale param emits an identical join under a different alias: wasteful, not wrong. A MALFORMED value is a different case and throws.
expected_query: with "base_years" as (SELECT unnest(ARRAY[2000,2001,2002,2003,2004,2005,2006,2007,2008,2009,2010,2011,2012,2013,2014,2015,2016,2017,2018,2019,2020,2021,2022,2023,2024,2025,2026]) as year), "player_years" as (SELECT DISTINCT player.pid, base_years.year FROM player CROSS JOIN base_years), "player_years_weeks" as (SELECT player_years.pid, nfl_year_week_timestamp.year, nfl_year_week_timestamp.week FROM player_years INNER JOIN nfl_year_week_timestamp ON player_years.year = nfl_year_week_timestamp.year) select "player"."pid", player.first_name, player.last_name, "tb4a345a0f5715a2d923e41fe875984ae"."keeptradecut_value" AS "player_keeptradecut_value_0", "player_years_weeks"."year", "player_years_weeks"."week", "player"."primary_position" from "player" inner join "player_years" on "player_years"."pid" = "player"."pid" inner join "player_years_weeks" on "player_years_weeks"."pid" = "player"."pid" and "player_years_weeks"."year" = "player_years"."year" left join "opening_days" on "opening_days"."year" = "player_years_weeks"."year" left join "nfl_year_week_timestamp" on "nfl_year_week_timestamp"."year" = "player_years_weeks"."year" and "nfl_year_week_timestamp"."week" = "player_years_weeks"."week" inner join "keeptradecut_valuations" as "tb4a345a0f5715a2d923e41fe875984ae" on "tb4a345a0f5715a2d923e41fe875984ae"."pid" = "player"."pid" and "tb4a345a0f5715a2d923e41fe875984ae"."is_superflex" = true and "tb4a345a0f5715a2d923e41fe875984ae"."observed_at" = (select MAX(observed_at) from "keeptradecut_valuations" where "pid" = player.pid and "is_superflex" = true and "keeptradecut_value" is not null and "observed_at" <= to_timestamp(nfl_year_week_timestamp.week_timestamp)) group by player.first_name, player.last_name, "tb4a345a0f5715a2d923e41fe875984ae"."keeptradecut_value", "player_years_weeks"."year", "player_years_weeks"."week", "player"."pid", "player"."last_name", "player"."first_name", "player"."primary_position" order by "player"."pid" asc limit 10
